summary: First-finish smoke test for Chahal Ayurvedic Clinic bilingual site. All 5 backend endpoints and all frontend flows verified via Playwright against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
passed: GET /api/ returns 200 with message 'Chahal Ayurvedic Clinic API is running'
GET /api/clinic-info returns full clinic JSON (name, doctor, phone, whatsapp, address, tagline_en, tagline_pa)
POST /api/appointments creates entry with id + created_at; returns 422 when required fields (name/problem) missing
GET /api/appointments returns list including just-created appointment (most recent first)
POST /api/contact with phone succeeds; returns 400 'Provide phone or email' when both missing
Home page shows 'Authentic Ayurveda', Punjabi tagline 'ਹਰ ਬਿਮਾਰੀ ਦਾ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਇਲਾਜ', doctor name
Hero CTAs present: hero-book-btn, hero-call-btn, hero-whatsapp-btn
All navbar links (home/about/treatments/gallery/contact) navigate to correct routes
Language toggle switches EN↔PA content; persists via localStorage key 'cac-lang' (not 'lang')
Treatments page renders 12 treatment cards including treatment-card-pcod, hair-fall, infertility

Contact form submission: filled name/phone/problem/date, clicked submit, sonner toast appeared ('Appointment request received. We will call you soon.'), fields reset; backend verified via GET returning new appointment
Floating WhatsApp button present with correct wa.me/919417258159 href
Mobile toggle opens mobile nav on 390x844 viewport (verified via screenshot)
notes: Language persistence uses localStorage key 'cac-lang' per implementation; requirement stated 'localStorage' which is satisfied. Test initially checked wrong key but code confirms persistence works correctly.
